MINISTRY OF CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLICDISTRIBUTION
(Department of Consumer Affairs)
NOTIFICATION
New Delhi, the 4th December, 2014
G.S.R. 870(E).In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) read with clause ()
of sub-section (2) of Section 52. of the Legal Metrology Act, 2009 (1 of 2010), the Central
Government hereby makes the following rules further to amend the Legal Metrology (Packaged
Commodities) Rules, 2011, namely:
I. (1) These fules may be called as the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) (Second)
(Amendment) Rules, 2014.
(2) They shall come into force from the date of their publication in Official Gazette.
2, In the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 20ii in rule 26, after clause (d),
the following clause shall be inserted, namely:
(e)any'thread which is sold in coil to handloom weavers.".
[F. No. WM-10(47)/2013]
MANOJKUMARPARIDA,Jt.SeCy.
Note  The principal notification was published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part-Il,
Section 3, Sub-section (i), vide notification number G.S.R. 202(E), dated the 7th March,
201 1 and last amended vide notification number G.S.R. 137, dated the 16th June, 2014.
